name: cypress-playwright-api-tests
description: Testes de API REST com Cypress e Playwright: 66 cenários de dados, schema, contrato, autenticação, CRUD e cenários negativos, com Allure Report
author: Moisés Chiaretto

scripts.allure:cy: allure generate allure-results/cypress --clean --single-file -o allure-report/cypress --name Cypress-API && allure open allure-report/cypress
scripts.allure:pw: allure generate allure-results/playwright --clean --single-file -o allure-report/playwright --name Playwright-API && allure open allure-report/playwright
